name: Niraamaya Retreats
summary: Niraamaya Retreats is an Ayurveda-led collection of retreats across Kerala, set on a cliff above the Arabian Sea at Kovalam, beside Vembanad Lake at Kumarakom and in a spice estate near Periyar at Thekkady. Its Kovalam property grew out of the 1982 Octagon House heritage-architecture initiative and was re-envisioned as Niraamaya in 2012.
highlights: Surya Samudra, Kovalam: restored traditional Kerala homes and cottages on a cliff over the Arabian Sea
Backwaters & Beyond, Kumarakom: lakeside villas with pool and 160 m of Vembanad shoreline
Cardamom Club, Thekkady: stilted cottages in a spice estate next to Periyar reserve, 13 cottages
Yoga, meditation and Ayurveda programmes offered at the retreats
Brand history traces to the 1982 Octagon House at Kovalam
